## Validation Complete

I've verified the three auditor reports and the generated code. Here are my findings:

**min_index_bug · CONFIRMED P0** — `new/dart-gen-bs/gen_app_sechirut_ent1.dart:54`: The computed field `תקרה נמוכה` uses `_v[10]` and `_v[11]` which only exist when editing an existing record. When creating a new record, `_v` contains only indices [0-8] (user input fields), so both indices default to 0, giving `min(0,0)=0` instead of `min(rent×3, rent×months÷3)`. **Auditors 1 & 2 are correct; Auditor 3 misanalyzed.** Fix: compute directly from source fields like c26/c27/c28 do.

**min_index_bug_display · CONFIRMED P0** — `new/dart-gen-bs/gen_app_sechirut_ent1.dart:208`: Same root cause in the live display (`_calc`). When user edits rent/months, the display still reads stale cache values _v[10]/[11] instead of recomputing. Fix: same formula-based computation.

**regression_shared_infrastructure · CONFIRMED P0** — Three critical shared build files (ship.mjs, one.mjs, tighten-types.mjs) have been gutted to 3-line blocking stubs instead of their 138/248/257 line implementations. This breaks the shared pipeline for all apps/teams. The protocol permits only police-bench.mjs to run. **Auditor 3 correctly flagged this.** Fix: restore all three from HEAD.

```
FIX-LIST: min_index_bug, min_index_bug_display, regression_shared_infrastructure
```
